title: From data to decisions: how LSEG is scaling trusted AI
summary: See how LSEG uses OpenAI to scale trusted AI across its global business, accelerating insights, shrinking release cycles, and empowering 4,000 employees.
body: See how LSEG uses OpenAI to scale trusted AI across its global business, accelerating insights, shrinking release cycles, and empowering 4,000 employees.
summaryZh: LSEG（伦敦证券交易所集团）展示了其如何利用OpenAI的大模型技术在全公司范围内扩展可信赖的人工智能，从而加速洞察生成、缩短产品发布周期，并赋能全球4000多名员工。原始信息显示：See how LSEG uses OpenAI to scale trusted AI across its global business, accelerating insights, shrinking release cycles, and empowering 4,000 employees.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“From data to decisions: how LSEG is scaling trusted AI”。其重要性主要体现在：该文章介绍了LSEG（伦敦证券交易所集团）如何应用OpenAI技术在其全球业务中扩展可信赖AI，属于真实世界的LLM企业落地案例。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
